text:
[issue by moritz-htk]
### Minecraft Version

26.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Describe the Issue

The game crashes with only Balm installed on 26.1.1 Forge before the main menu appears.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Create a new instance in Prism Launcher on Windows 11
2. Install Minecraft 26.1.1 and Forge 63.0.1
3. Install Balm 26.1.1.1 for Forge from Modrinth
4. Launch the game and wait for the crash

### Logs

https://mclo.gs/dPB0kFZ

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26519251/latest.log)

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Fixed in Balm 26.1.1.2
